NewsArticle.Title: Server Reboot
NewsArticle.Content: - 09.17 17:11 PDT A Dark Ages server rebooted unexpectedly. Service resumed immediately. The error was isolated and corrected; the fix was dynamically loaded within 30 minutes. At all other times all Dark Ages servers are stable. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
